title.narrative: Programa de Apoyo a la Poltica de Vivienda

description.narrative: THE PURPOSE OF THE PROGRAM IS TO IMPROVE THE EFICICIENCY OF THE HOUSING MARKET AND TO RAISE THE LEVEL AND QUALITY OF LIFE OF LOW INCOME GROUPS THROUGH BARRIO UPGRADING, I.E. WATER DISTRIBUTION AND SANITATION, STREET PAVEMENT AND OTHER BASIC SERVICES. THE PROGRAM ALSO INCLUDES REFORM OF LEGAL AN REGULATORY FRAMEWORK OF HOUSING MARKET, REFORM PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS WHICH PARTICIPATE IN HOUSING FINANCE, AND STRENGTHENING OF MORTGAGE BACKED CREDIT MECANISMS. .
